title: Bot Factions In The Lobby
description: The host can give each bot a faction when adding it (default Random) and change it afterwards from the seat list. The seed deals every undecided seat a different faction from what is left of the six played factions; a faction can be held by one seat only, and the server refuses duplicates and unknown factions with a reason. The random bot is no longer offered in the lobby: the rule bot is the only choice, so the buttons read 'Add bot' and 'Fill empty seats with bots'. The faction badges are monograms (the project ships no faction art). Synthetic: the real lobby components against a mocked server that answers like the real one, regenerated by npm run screenshots -- CY.
